profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer @ Morehouse School of Medicine | MS Biotechnology | Health Equity Tracker
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer at Morehouse School of Medicine working on computational health research and data platforms.

I work on the Health Equity Tracker, an open-source platform that analyzes CDC health surveillance data to identify disparities. My role involves building data pipelines, conducting geospatial analysis, and supporting epidemiological research.

I recently co-authored research on HIV care disparities (presented at APHA 2025) and I'm currently expanding this work to examine cancer outcomes. I'm also pursuing an MS in Biotechnology to better integrate molecular biology with computational approaches.

I'm interested in roles combining software engineering, health data science, and biomedical research—particularly in areas like computational oncology or cancer epidemiology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of the healthequitytracker.org project, I am dedicated to illuminating health disparities across the US through data-driven insights. My work revolves around enhancing the website's functionality, introducing new metrics, and developing impactful data visualizations to present a comprehensive view of health inequities.

Frontend: ReactJS
Backend: Python, Pandas, NumPy
Cloud & DevOps: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Airflow, BigQuery, Terraform

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I specialized in developing high-quality, performant web and native applications. I contributed to a project of significant impact that supports churches and nonprofits in fundraising efforts. My role involved close collaboration with the Product Design and Engineering teams to ensure the delivery of critical app functionalities.

App Development: Reason, React Native, ReactJS
Data Handling: GraphQL
Collaboration: Agile development methodologies, cross-functional team coordination

positions.title: Subrogation Data Analyst
positions.description:
- Analyzed medical claims data to identify and process reimbursements from Michigan Catastrophic Claims Association (MCCA) for catastrophic injury cases
- Reviewed complex medical bills, injury documentation, and claim files to determine eligibility for reimbursement
- Submitted reimbursement requests with proper medical documentation and supporting evidence to MCCA
- Built Tableau dashboards to track outstanding payments, submitted claims, and received reimbursements, enabling real-time monitoring of MCCA reimbursement pipeline
- Performed data analysis on missed subrogation referrals using predictive analytics to identify recovery opportunities
- Collaborated with business leaders to define technical requirements for medical claims processing applications
- Prepared analytical reports tracking reimbursement patterns, process improvements, and operational metrics
- Documented system requirements for new technologies integrating medical billing and claims data
